Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.

Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
When Prowling Geistcatcher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Delver.
When Phyrexian Delver dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Phyrexian Delver from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Holding priority, repeat steps 7 through 10 one time, sacrificing Gray Merchant instead.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Put Machine God's Effigy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Machine God's Effigy and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Repeat.

Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Helga.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake spell.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
